summary: pkg/crud: new schema options crud.TenantScoped() and crud.WithTenantField(name), plus the optional crud.TenantScopedSchema interface and crud.SchemaTenantField helper. For a tenant-scoped schema, DefaultRepository adds the context tenant to the WHERE clause of Get, Exists, GetAll, List, Count, Update and Delete, writes the context tenant on Create, never rewrites the tenant column on Update, and fails with PermissionDenied when the context has no tenant. CrudController no longer accepts values for Hidden fields from submitted forms: Create fills them from InitialValue and Update keeps the stored value.
